verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is an open-source local inference engine. It can be self-hosted by building from source, using pre-built release binaries, Docker or Winget, and it ships a `llama serve` server with a built-in web UI. Community reports confirm users running it on their own hardware, with one calling it 'very nice for something self-hosted.' Missing for 10: in-pack detail on production self-hosting concerns (auth, scaling, deployment hardening) beyond pointers to the Docker and build docs.
